response: HackerRank cannot review individual test answers, adjust scores, or contact companies on behalf of candidates. If you believe there was a technical error in the test report (e.g., a timeout or missing submission), you can refer to the error descriptions in Document 4. For any concerns about the hiring process or next steps, you should contact the recruiter or hiring company directly.
justification: Document 5 explains that coding question scoring is automatic and based solely on test case results, with no partial credit. As a candidate, you cannot reschedule the assessment yourself through HackerRank. You need to contact the hiring company or recruiter who sent you the invitation. They are the test administrators and have the ability to modify the test schedule or send a new invitation.

According to HackerRank's documentation for test administrators:
- They can **modify the test expiration time** (start and end date/time) to extend the testing window (Document 2).
- If you already attempted the test but had issues (e.g., power outage, internet loss), they can **reinvite you to retake the test** at any time (Document 3).
- They can also add **time accommodations** (extra duration) if needed (Document 1).

Please reach out to your contact at "Company Name" and ask them to adjust the test expiration dates or send a new invitation for a later time.
justification: Document 2 shows test admins can modify test expiration time (start/end date & time) in Settings > General. Document 3 shows admins can reinvite candidates to retake a test. response:
To remove an interviewer (or any user) from the platform, you need to deactivate their account via the User Management section in the Admin Panel. Here are the steps:

1. Log in to your HackerRank for Work account.
2. Click your profile icon in the upper-right corner and select **Admin Panel**.
3. In the Admin Panel, click your profile icon again and select **User Management**.
4. Use the search bar or filters to locate the interviewer you want to remove.
5. Click the **ellipsis (⋯)** icon next to the user's name.
6. Select **Deactivate User**.
7. Click **Deactivate** in the confirmation dialog.

The user's status will change to **Deactivated**, which effectively removes their access. If you don't see the **Deactivate User** option when clicking the three dots, ensure you are in the **User Management** area (not in an interview-specific view) and that you have admin permissions.
justification: Document 1 provides the procedure for deactivating a user via User Management in the Admin Panel, which is the documented way to remove a user from the platform. The steps include accessing User Management, clicking the ellipsis next to the user's name, and selecting Deactivate User. The user's issue of not seeing the option may be due to being in the wrong section (e.g., interview templates) or lacking admin rights.

response:
You can pause your HackerRank subscription instead of canceling it, provided you meet the prerequisites. The Pause Subscription feature is available for individual self-serve plan subscribers with an active monthly subscription (Individual Monthly, Basic, or Interview Monthly) that started at least 30 days ago.

**Steps to pause your subscription:**
1. Click your profile icon in the top-right corner and select **Settings**.
2. Navigate to the **Billing** section under **Subscription**.
3. Click the **Cancel Plan** button – a prompt about the Pause Subscription feature will appear.
4. Select a pause duration (minimum 1 month, maximum 12 months).
5. Click **Confirm Pause**. A confirmation message will show the pause duration and automatic resume date.

**To resume early:** Log in during the paused period, click **Resume Early** on the popup, go to the Billing page, click **Resume Plan**, and confirm.

**To extend the pause:** While paused, go to the Billing page, click **Cancel Subscription**, choose **Extend Pause**, select a new duration, and confirm.

If your subscription is a HackerRank for Work (team) plan, the self-serve pause feature may not apply; in that case, please contact support for assistance.
justification: Document 1 details the Pause Subscription feature, prerequisites, and step-by-step instructions for individual self-serve monthly plans. Document 2 covers cancellation for HackerRank for Work plans, indicating a different workflow for team subscriptions.
